Skipping the next instalment is possible: on Groww, go to My SIPs, select the SIP, click Edit SIP and choose Skip Installment. Only one instalment can be skipped at a time, and another can be requested after the first skipped date has passed. Your 5 Nov 2026 instalment is already in progress and is not affected. Note that skipping three consecutive instalments will automatically cancel the SIP. If the next instalment is due within two days, a skip request will not apply to that instalment but to the ones after. Units already allotted are not affected by skipping.
